verdict.rationale: ROS 2's own materials describe an ecosystem spanning "drivers to state-of-the-art algorithms," with packaged installs via Ubuntu debs. Community reports corroborate a large pool of reusable nodes and drivers (e.g., a UR arm controller), plus behaviors like Nav2 navigation, SLAM, motion planning, teleop and shared message packages such as vision_msgs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a package registry/index or dependency-resolution workflow for discovering and pulling packages, and evidence on the breadth and quality of hardware driver coverage (one user notes the Open Robotics debs aren't suitable for most product deployments).
